method.words: Word count of the prose (model titles are dropped first).
method.mattr: Moving-average type-token ratio over 50-word windows: how much of the vocabulary is fresh, averaged over every window so length does not skew it. Higher means more varied words.
method.mtld: Measure of textual lexical diversity (McCarthy and Jarvis 2010): how many words it takes, on average, before the running type-token ratio falls to 0.72, read forwards and backwards. Higher means richer vocabulary.
method.yule_k: Yule's K: 10,000 x (sum of squared word frequencies minus length) / length squared. Higher means more repetition of the same words.
method.distinct_1: Unique single words divided by all words, pooled over the group's ten stories.
method.distinct_2: Unique word pairs divided by all word pairs, pooled over the group. Low means the ten stories reuse the same phrases.
method.distinct_3: Unique word triples divided by all triples, pooled over the group.
method.self_overlap: Average Jaccard similarity (shared / total) between the word-trigram sets of every pair of stories in the group. Higher means the stories echo each other.
method.title_repeat: Share of a model's stories whose title (ignoring case) matches another of its titles.
method.openers: The first four words of each story and how many of the ten share them.
method.names: Capitalised words that are not at the start of a sentence (mostly character and place names). Models: top ten with counts. Humans: only the number of distinct names.
method.ai_vocab_rate: Occurrences per 1,000 words of a fixed list of words typical of AI prose (whisper, tapestry, echo, flicker, ...).
method.map: All stories embedded as 1536-number vectors, mean-centred, squashed to two axes by PCA (singular value decomposition). Nearby points read alike.
method.spread: Mean cosine distance from each story to its group's centroid, in the full 1536 dimensions. Small means the group's stories are alike.
method.closest_pair: The two stories of a model that are most similar by cosine similarity.
